mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last 3 months signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over the last 3 months signals increased consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals increased economic output and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL) below 2% for 3 consecutive months signals a potential for continued accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between low inflation and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 within the last month signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in real personal savings (RSAFS) by more than 5% and an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals increased consumer spending and inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases > 5% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the joint effect of RSAFS decrease and CPIAUCSL increase on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over the last 6 months signals a strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the signal, or the correlation between GDP increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
